messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none.

item: "valid prescription from licensed healthcare provider"
set: ["valid prescription from licensed healthcare provider", "healthcare provider", "tell healthcare provider if taking prescription or over-the-counter medicines", "healthcare provider or adult caregiver", "prescription", "inform healthcare provider about liver problems", "inform healthcare provider about kidney problems", "inform healthcare provider about Asian descent", "inform healthcare provider about thyroid problems", "take exactly as prescribed by healthcare provider", "keep all follow-up visits with healthcare provider", "call your healthcare provider if this happens", "call healthcare provider if symptoms are severe", "call healthcare provider if have new pain", "inform healthcare provider about all medical conditions", "if light blinks red, call healthcare provider"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
